# Igris Inertial

> Igris is one execution system for AI tasks you can verify. It helps engineers send a request through one API surface, govern execution, inspect events, and verify signed records after the run.

## Product Model

Request -> Execute -> Verify

- Request: submit a chat, task, or tool-using run through one Igris API surface
- Execute: Igris applies boundaries, records execution events, and runs work in hosted, local, or hybrid environments
- Verify: Igris returns execution metadata and verification-ready receipts

## Deployment Modes

- Hosted: provider-backed execution through the control plane
- Local: execution closer to where work happens
- Hybrid: hosted coordination plus local execution where needed

These are deployment modes of one system, not separate products.

## Proof Language

- Proven locally: unified local proof path and receipt verification
- Source-confirmed: code exists but no reproducible proof artifact is captured here
- Technical preview: runnable or exposed surfaces with limited proof or production evidence
- In development: partial or not-yet-proven behavior

Preview-heavy areas such as robotics, ROS2, multimodal execution, local fallback, and coordinated rollout should be read using those labels.
